entries.source: Camelot Warcry quest 991 'Trial of Intelligence (SI)' (Wayback capture 2004-11-02, period-data/archive/wayback-warcry): the trainer sends you to Idena Blaimmel 'West and around the corner'; her riddle wants TWO legs of the marine fungus; 'Return to Idena and hand her both legs to receive 6 Silver and some Copper'; reward 22 experience; prerequisite Trial of Strength; classes Rogue, Viking
entries.why: the two marine fungus legs Idena's riddle asks for (a quest token, copied from the Trial of Strength marine fungus root token)

row.StepText: Find Idena Blaimmel west of your trainer, around the corner in Aegirhamn, and hear her riddle.|Idena's riddle names the marine fungus: kill one in the waters south of Aegirhamn and take its leg.|She wants TWO legs: kill a second marine fungus.|Return to Idena and hand her both legs.

entries.why: the middle Aegir trial was missing: Torold's Trial of Bravery offer says 'Idena spoke of your intelligence in dealing with those riddles', and Idena Blaimmel already stands in Aegirhamn (288537,353782; CapnBry sighting 2684); built from the Warcry spoiler (the riddle text itself is recorded nowhere, so no dialogue is added)
quest markers for the new Trial of Intelligence (Idena Blaimmel; the marine fungus shore the Trial of Strength marker uses)

Trial of Bravery comes after the trials of strength and intelligence (Warcry 991 prerequisite chain; Allakhazam 552 comment: 'I had to complete another quest, called the Trial of Intelligence (Level 2), before I was given the Trial of Bravery')

two live Loken epic bosses 3.3k apart; the period one (CapnBry sighting 3177, zone 108 local 46960,25153 = 636784,762433) is cb757cf0 at 636788,762435, which Seer50.cs also uses; the stray copy at 639272,764711 is archived

set.StepText: Get the spores of a dew sheerie on the eastern shore of the loch, east of Ardagh.|Take the spores to Cait in Howth.|Get otherworld soil from a deamhan creig (or ask Merlo near Howth for [soil from the otherworld]).|Return to Cait.|Ainrebh the enchanter in Caille must seal the magic between the soil and the spores.|Get the grass seeds from the grass sheerie named Fearan, on the hill west-northwest of Caille (he runs the hill crest with a companion).|Return the seeds to Ainrebh.|Return to Fianait in Ardee with the otherworld potted soil.

entries.why: the finale was 'reconstructed' (spec note): any grass sheerie dropped the seeds and the quest ended on a Fearan kill; walkthrough Hib 174: 'stumble upon the grass sheerie named Fearan ... With grass seeds in hand, I returned to Ainrebh ... returned to Fianait in triumph', so Fearan carries the seeds and the quest ends at Fianait
step 6 is now Fearan himself (his spawn on the Bri Leith hill crest)
the quest now ends at Fianait in Ardee
step text says 'hill northwest of Snowdonia Station' but the marker pointed at the Camelot Hills queen; two dragon ant queens stand on the Black Mtns. North hill (515227,395921 and 514809,395920)

marker was on the Forest Sauvage fellwoods; the walkthrough (Alb 501) puts the ebony fellwoods at the Campacorentin / Salisbury Plains zone line (58000/19000), where the fellwood group around 541341,600749 stands

step 3 search area was a placeholder 32k circle (581632,581632 r32768) over all of Salisbury Plains; the walkthrough says 'walk up right next to the 2 crates in the camp', so the search is now radius 800 around the slaver camp (slavers, slave masters and Slave Master Cottrel at 605300-606400 / 564000-565000)
